scene.heading: La piazza, sera
scene.summary: Anna incontra Marco davanti alla fontana e gli porge una lettera.

project.title: Il corto di Anna
project.idea: Una donna torna nella sua città natale per ritrovare un vecchio amico

style.label: Realistico
style.hint: photorealistic live-action film still, natural skin tones

cinematography.label: Camera a mano, luce calda
cinematography.description: Vicina ai personaggi, intima, un po’ mossa
cinematography.camera: handheld camera, subtle natural shake, close and medium shots

characters.name: Anna
characters.description: Una donna sui 35 anni che torna nella sua città natale

appearance.prompt: a woman in her mid-30s, curly red hair, freckles, light denim jacket

characters.name: Marco
characters.description: Un vecchio amico di Anna, rimasto in paese a fare il fabbro

appearance.clothing: grembiule di cuoio sopra una camicia a quadri
appearance.prompt: a sturdy man in his early 40s, short dark hair, trimmed beard, leather apron over a plaid shirt

locations.name: La piazza del paese
locations.prompt: a small town square at sunset, warm light

cameraMovements.label: Avvicinati
cameraMovements.description: La camera si avvicina piano al soggetto
cameraMovements.hint: slow, steady push-in, the camera moves closer to the subject
cameraMovements.endFrameHint: the camera has moved closer: tighter framing on the subject, same angle

cameraMovements.label: Resta fermo
cameraMovements.endFrameHint: the camera has not moved: same framing, only the subjects have moved

cameraMovements.label: Allontanati
cameraMovements.description: La camera si allontana piano dal soggetto
cameraMovements.hint: slow, steady pull-out, the camera moves away from the subject
cameraMovements.endFrameHint: the camera has moved back: wider framing on the subject

cameraMovements.label: Panoramica
cameraMovements.description: La camera ruota da un lato all’altro
cameraMovements.endFrameHint: the camera has panned: same position, new part of the scene in frame
